title_en: Build for the Water: Exposure, Moisture and Sandcastle Survival
title_zh: 迎水而建：暴露、水分与沙堡寿命
identity_zh: 固定自主周期终稿，包含两轮科学反馈；封存后同题学习之前的版本。
identity_en: Final manuscript from a fixed autonomous cycle, including two scientific feedback rounds, sealed before same-task reference learning.
assessment_zh: 当前 22 页整稿由作者外 AI 评阅，Meritorious 中心、Honorable Mention–Finalist 相邻；未校准，非官方奖项。
assessment_en: Author-external AI review of the current 22-page paper: Meritorious-centered, adjacent Honorable Mention–Finalist; uncalibrated and not an official award.
strength_zh: 以明确适用域的几何界、水分守恒和固定阻力对照解释形状、降雨与初始湿度为何改变寿命排名。
strength_en: Combines geometric bounds with explicit domains, water conservation and fixed-resistance controls to explain design reversals under rain and moisture changes.
limits_zh: 侵蚀系数未实测；半体积留存不等于实际承载或局部冲刷失效；动态候选搜索不证明全局最优。封存前意外看到同题学生材料搜索摘要，影响未知，非严格盲测。
limits_en: No measured erosion coefficients; half-volume survival does not establish load-bearing or local-scour performance. Dynamic candidate searches do not prove global optimality. An accidental same-task student search snippet appeared before sealing; its influence is unknown, so no strict blindness is claimed.
review_scope_zh: 当前 22 页文本与版面、全部图表及两页公众文章；指定新增独立检查，不变科学对象按既有证据接续。定向复核中曾收到协调者结论，新增独立计算先已保存，不声称答案隔离。
review_scope_en: Current text and layout of all 22 pages, all figures and tables, and the two-page public article; targeted added checks with identity-based reuse of unchanged evidence. The follow-up later received coordinator conclusions after new independent calculations were saved, so it was not answer-isolated.
reviewer_identity_zh: 作者外 AI 评阅，同一评阅者复核；非真人或技术盲审。确切实际模型身份未知。
reviewer_identity_en: Author-external AI review with follow-up by the same reviewer; neither human nor technically blind. Exact served model identity is unknown.
